name: Internet Services of Virtual Communities
summary: Melbourne-based ISP; acquired the AustarMetro customer base (c. 2003, Austar's metro ISP brand descended from Eisa); acquired by iiNet in 2004.

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture of virtual.net.au Dec 1996.

Acquired the AustarMetro customer base (Melbourne, c. 2003) - Austar's metro dialup brand descended from Eisa Limited (eisametro.com.au / eisa.com.au); the base passed to iiNet with the 2004 acquisition (see austarmetro -> virtual-communities -> iinet).

refs.label: Whirlpool (Oct 2005): iiNet bought the austarmetro customer base from Virtual Communities in 2004
